lastCompletedStory.title: Add curated invariants block to scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md and demote patterns.md to grep-on-demand there

nextStoryContext: US-002 (implementer agent) should point at the curated invariants block added in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md's 'Codebase Patterns' section (1364 bytes, well under the 2.5KB cap) and drop the AGENTS.md reference plus the mandatory full-read of patterns.md — the grep-on-demand wording pattern used here ('grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for the section/keywords matching the subsystem this story touches') is the template to reuse in the .claude/agents/implementer.md system prompt. Note: no AGENTS.md file exists in this repo (confirmed via find), so US-002's 'drop AGENTS.md ref' likely targets the implementer agent's own prose, not a real file. patterns.md itself (292KB) was left untouched per this story's scope; it still needs no restructuring for grep-on-demand to work since it's already bullet-per-line.
